title: The Silent Shepherd
description:
The Silent Shepherd 🕊️You're tired. Anxious. Overwhelmed. Come rest here.Soft scripture readings paired with gentle, peaceful music — created for the moments when your soul needs to hear the Good Shepherd's voice more than anything else. Whether you're drifting to sleep, quieting a racing mind, or just needing a few minutes of stillness, you are safe here."He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters. He restores my soul." — Psalm 23:2–3✝️ What you'll find on this channel:
→ Peaceful Bible readings for sleep & deep rest
→ Calming scripture for anxiety, worry & overwhelm
→ Soft Christian music for prayer & meditation
→ Weekly videos for tired, faithful hearts📅 New videos every week — because your spirit deserves rest too.Subscribe and let the Good Shepherd lead you into peace. 🕊️
